description: S45 T5 (TD5/PM7/PM8): proposal.reject {id, reason} — the reasoned no. It carries NO digest (the refusal needs no binding to what was read: nothing is applied, so there is nothing to bind — the row can only be refused once, and a decided row is immutable history whatever its payload became) and produces NO effect: no policy row, no MCP change, no consent prompt. The reason is required, non-empty, and ≤ 512 bytes (the audit column's budget), and the answer is just the row: decided once, decided_by_kind='user', decided_by_id the connection's peer uid (never a param), decide_reason exactly the sentence the human typed. One policy_change row stands behind it (op='reject', ids-only summary, the proposal named) — the audit trail's only sentence for the decision.
